Futbolo Klubas Kauno Žalgiris is a professional football club based in Kaunas, Lithuania, that competes in the TOPLYGA, the top tier division of Lithuania. The club was founded as FM Spyris Kaunas in 2004, became the section of BC Žalgiris, and moved to their current stadium Darius and Girėnas Stadium in 2015. After their debut season in the A Lyga, the club adopted the name FK Kauno Žalgiris in 2016.
